correctness.rationale: For the variety with commutative associative addition, associative distributive multiplication, x²=x, no nullary constants, the free two-generator multiplicative band has six word classes a,b,ab,ba,aba,bab. The identity (x+x)²=x+x forces 4x=2x and hence positive coefficient classes 1,2,3. The 4095 nonzero six-term coefficient vectors form a finite polynomial semiring P; taking the least congruence generated by all p~p² yields exactly the free algebra by the universal property. Closure under six monomial-addition and four left/right generator-multiplication contexts is complete by distributivity and generation. An independent reimplementation from the inspected verify.py computed 4001 unions, 44105 processed pairs, 94 classes, the stated class histogram, checked all quotient identities across 94³ triples, and examined all 94² ordered generating pairs, finding precisely the generator pair and its swap. Thus |F_MI(a,b)|=94 and Aut=C2. The computation is exhaustive over a proved finite universal quotient, not an arbitrary finite sample.

Its exact 94-element size, complete congruence mechanism, automorphism group, and exact generating-pair rigidity substantially sharpen the known coarse 4095 polynomial bound. A natural minimal-rank classification can be valuable without a formula for every rank.
